operating_policy.write_scope: repository-local tracked architecture, generation, audit, and release artifacts only
operating_policy.service_architecture_rule: Incident management coordinates containment/RCA only. Research, editorial, verification, release engineering, publication records, and governance remain independent services connected by router contracts.
operating_policy.space_separation_rule: Development, verification, and release spaces are separate logical spaces. Source rebinding happens in verification space; owner-approved publication controls are then re-applied as an explicit release-space migration, never by editing product artifacts directly.
